verdicts.reason: Both are almost the same layout. In both, the peach circle is a large empty area with the shoe pushed to its lower-left edge, 'Every mixed case.' is squeezed into three lines next to the CTA so it looks like an orphan, and the legal line is shrunk to about 6 px, too small to read. The only difference is that B puts 'WEEKEND ONLY' tight against the top edge with a bigger gap to the headline, while A spaces the eyebrow and headline more evenly, which is slightly better.
